scripts.mcp: npm run build && node dist/kubeconvert.js mcp
scripts.doctor: npm run build && node dist/kubeconvert.js doctor
scripts.build:binary:linux-x64: npm run build && pkg dist/kubeconvert.js --target node22-linux-x64 --output ../../release/kubeconvert-linux-x64
scripts.build:binary:linux-arm64: npm run build && pkg dist/kubeconvert.js --target node22-linux-arm64 --no-bytecode --public-packages '*' --public --output ../../release/kubeconvert-linux-arm64
scripts.build:binary: npm run build:binary:linux-x64 && npm run build:binary:linux-arm64 && (cd ../../release && shasum -a 256 kubeconvert-linux-* > SHA256SUMS)
